todos.title: Testing alert box not appearing at end of test cycle
todos.description: When using STCheck::debug('test'), the test cycles through all tables but the final alert('Test finished') does not appear

analysis.expectedBehavior: At the end of all table tests, an alert box should display 'Test finished' followed by page redirect
analysis.actualBehavior: Test finishes (visible in selftable_test_report.txt) but alert box never appears

bFinishedSetAt.line1080: When no more containers to test and no back_tables link
bFinishedSetAt.line1138: When result is not NOERROR/BOXDISPLAY but status not finished
bFinishedSetAt.line1327: When no more table buttons found (makeNextTableContainer_Test)
bFinishedSetAt.line1342: When no action links exist in makeNextTableContainer_Test

possibleCauses: Page redirect executing before alert is dismissed
Script not being properly rendered in HTML output

stepsToReproduce: 1. Set STCheck::debug('test') in your test file
2. Create an STSiteCreator with database tables
4. Observe test cycles but no final alert
debuggingSteps: 1. Check selftable_test_report.txt - if 'Test finished on...' appears, $bFinished was true
2. View page source after test completes - look for setTimeout script with alert
3. Check browser console for JavaScript errors
4. Test with different browser to rule out alert blocking
todos.suggestedFix: Add console.log before alert() to verify script execution, or use a modal dialog instead of native alert()

todos.title: Test report shows tables only with test.see debug mode
todos.description: With debug('test') alone, successful table tests are not written to selftable_test_report.txt

analysis.codeSnippet: if(!STCheck::isDebug('test.see')) return ''; // should not write anything into report
analysis.explanation: This is intentional - only errors are logged by default. Use debug('test.see') to see all pages

todos.resolution: This is working as designed. Documentation should clarify the difference between 'test' and 'test.see' modes

todos.title: Add summary statistics to test report
todos.description: The test report should include a summary at the end showing total tables tested, errors found, time per table, etc.
